description: This script automates code generation for internal Vulkan shaders in the ANGLE project, including shader variation handling, file generation, and build integration.

classes.name: CompileQueue
classes.description: Manages asynchronous shader compilation and preprocessing jobs using multiprocessing.

classes.name: CompileQueue.CompileToSPIRV
classes.description: Handles asynchronous shader compilation to SPIR-V.

classes.name: ShaderAndVariations
classes.description: Represents a shader and its variation parameters, managing variation bit calculations.

methods.name: get_var_name
methods.description: Generates a variable name for a shader or variation based on filename.

methods.name: get_namespace_name
methods.description: Generates a namespace name from a shader filename.

methods.name: get_variation_table_name
methods.description: Generates a variation table name from a shader filename.

methods.name: get_shader_id
methods.description: Creates an internal ID string for a shader.

methods.name: get_output_path
methods.description: Returns the output path for a generated shader file.

methods.name: get_glslang_exe_path
methods.description: Determines the path to the glslang validator executable based on platform.

methods.name: gen_shader_blob_entry
methods.description: Generates code for a shader blob array entry.

methods.name: slash
methods.description: Replaces backslashes with forward slashes in a string.

methods.name: gen_shader_include
methods.description: Generates an include directive for a shader.

methods.name: get_shader_variations
methods.description: Reads shader variation options from a JSON file.

methods.name: get_variation_bits
methods.description: Calculates bit lengths for flags and enums.

methods.name: next_enum_variation
methods.description: Iterates to the next variation combination.

methods.name: cleanup_preprocessed_shader
methods.description: Removes excessive blank lines from shader source.

methods.name: compile_variation
methods.description: Prepares and queues shader compilation with specific variations.

methods.name: get_variation_name
methods.description: Retrieves variation name or option string.

methods.name: get_variation_args
methods.description: Retrieves additional arguments for a variation option.

methods.name: get_variation_definition
methods.description: Generates C++ namespace and enum definitions for shader variations.

methods.name: get_shader_table_h
methods.description: Generates header code for shader variation table.

methods.name: get_shader_table_cpp
methods.description: Generates C++ code for shader variation table.

methods.name: get_get_function_h
methods.description: Generates header declaration for shader getter function.

methods.name: get_get_function_cpp
methods.description: Generates implementation of shader getter function.

methods.name: get_destroy_call
methods.description: Generates code to destroy shaders.

methods.name: shader_path
methods.description: Returns the file path of a shader as a string.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function orchestrating shader code generation, compilation, and file output.
